_note: Michigan state legislative seats on the desk, Nov 3 2026 general. Tracked = OnPoint Politics' competitive set (24 House, 7 Senate, read 2026-11-02) plus every State House and State Senate contest on the Macomb County ballot. scope 'statewide': its own contest (mi-hd-NNN / mi-sd-NN), entered county by county (one manual entry per county portion; the Macomb portion comes from the Clerk summary-PDF contest named in portion_contest_id). scope 'macomb_only': the whole seat lies in Macomb, so the Macomb contest is the seat (no statewide copy). scope 'macomb_portion_only': on the Macomb ballot but outside the competitive set; the desk carries the Macomb portion only. A call entered on any id in call_ids is a call on the seat. Every Michigan House seat (2-year terms) and every Senate seat (4-year terms, elected with the governor) is on the 2026 ballot (Mich. Const. art. IV, secs. 2-3).

competitive_source.note: The pages list exactly these 24 House and 7 Senate districts. Labels are in the ratings layer (label, date, link only).

county_coverage_source.name: Michigan Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission plans in effect for 2026: remedial State House (Motown Sound FC E1) and State Senate (Crane A1) plans approved in 2024, linked from the MICRC Mapping Data page; all other districts unchanged from Hickory (House) and Linden (Senate)
county_coverage_source.method: Each district polygon (State of Michigan GIS, MGF V26) intersected with the State's county layer (MGF V26) in Michigan GeoRef metres. A county counts when the overlap is >= 0.1% of the district and >= 0.5 km2; for every seat here the smallest counted portion is 23.6 km2 and the largest discarded edge overlap 0.004 km2. area_share_pct is land+water area, not population.
county_coverage_source.cross_check: MICRC block-assignment files for the 2021 plans (Linden Senate Blocks, Hickory House Blocks; Census block GEOIDs carry the county): every House seat here matches; Senate 9, 12, 30, 32, 35, 37 match; SD-13 lost its Wayne portion and SD-24 its Genesee, Lapeer and Oakland portions under the 2024 remedial Senate plan, so SD-24 now lies entirely in Macomb (as the Clerk's ballot shows: no Multi-County label). The set of districts touching Macomb (Senate 9, 10, 11, 12, 24, 25; House 11, 12, 13, 14, 57-63, 65, 66) equals the Clerk's contest list.

county_pages_source.method: Each link was read on the county's own clerk or elections page (evidence_url). Where a county site challenges automated readers, the link is 'not confirmed' and the Secretary of State's county-links page entry is given as sos_listed_url for a browser.

state_results.note: Secretary of State results; challenges automated clients — browser only, cross-check against the county pages.
